description: Clears the document-level generatedAt so ReferenceArchitectures renders the ': null' arm of its syncDate ternary (src/components/ReferenceArchitectures/index.js line 23) and the '' arm beside it at line 33. Four other components read generatedAt, so clearing it moves five pages at once -- which is exactly why it belongs to the variant build rather than to the ordinary coverage build the real pages are measured from. The same overlay clears the five collections MetricsDashboard reads through an empty fallback: referenceArchitectureLifecycle.cards and referenceArchitectureLifecycle.omitted reach the `|| []` arms at src/components/MetricsDashboard/index.js lines 65 and 85, referenceArchitectureLifecycle.trends reaches the `|| {}` arm at line 76, and series and breakdowns reach the `|| {}` arms at lines 124 and 174. All five are document-level collections on the one file the /metrics page reads, so emptying them in the ordinary coverage build would trade every rendered card, trend, disclosure item, line chart and bar chart for the fallback rather than add a case; they belong to the variant build beside the real one. They are ordinary shapes rather than defensive dead code -- metrics.json is regenerated by `npm run collect:metrics`, and a collector run that cannot reach a source emits the document without that collection. trends is cleared here rather than left alone because the single-point sparkline arm it used to conflict with now lives in tests/e2e/fixtures/data/metrics.json, which `add`s a trend beside the real two in the ordinary build instead of appending a point onto the only trend that also reaches the no-values arm.
